note: Authored the replacement relevance-sentinel body against a spec naming the census pin as an untouchable constraint. Chose to capture git's rc with `|| rc=$?` and grep a file rather than trust a surviving pipeline, which is the correct shape (W97/W108) and was not spelled out in the spec. Two defects the gate corrected before applying: the emitted YAML indented `id:`/`run:` at 10 spaces under a 6-space `- name:`, and it wrote the changed-file list to a hardcoded /tmp path instead of $RUNNER_TEMP.

Blind cross-family refutation of the full diff. Found the one defect that mattered: grep's rc is three-valued (0 match, 1 no-match, >1 ERROR) and an if/else collapses 1 and >1, so a grep that could not READ the changed-file list would have been recorded as 'nothing relevant changed' and skipped the gate — a failure to measure reported as a measurement. Also found a comment that had become false ('ends at the sentinel', untrue once three unconditional steps were added below it) and that the test invoked plain bash rather than the `bash --noprofile --norc -e -o pipefail` GitHub actually uses. Its BLOCKER (PEP 668 would make the system pip install crash on ubuntu-latest) and its shallow-clone finding were REFUTED by measurement — see the pack's dissent. Confirmed independently as NOT-A-FINDING: merge_group.base_sha is the right key, three-dot is right on a queue ref, and the fail-open path is reachable under set -e because errexit is suspended on the left of ||.

The battle plan's named reviewer for workflow-class diffs. The whole Codex seat on this machine answers 'ERROR: Your workspace is out of credits' — measured on both gpt-5.6-sol and gpt-5.6-terra. Recorded because a seat that could not be reached is not a seat that agreed.
Socket read timeout at 400s, twice, on 20KB and 7.8KB prompts. The second of the two seats R9's allowlist would have accepted.
